However they didn't mention that excluding them changes the estimand (population). That's a scope issue, not necessarily unacknowledged data problem. Also they didn't address that -1 sentinel is missing, they excluded, that's fine. No other issues.

Thus main issue: Scope violation because they excluded QA orders, which are part of the defined population. So verdict revise, issue: scope.
